channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Branch Library
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Branch Library (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Branch Library: The Mission Bay Branch Library is on the ground floor of…
item.description: The Mission Bay Branch Library is on the ground floor of a multi-use building at 960 4th St, not in a stand-alone single-story building. The Assessor lists the library space itself as one story. Source: https://sfpl.org/locations/mission-bay/mission-bay-library-history ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200208093627.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Branch Library: The Mission Bay Library page now lists the city building…
item.description: The Mission Bay Library page now lists the city building permits for its building at 201 Berry St, including a 2005 permit to create the branch library; the library's own opening date, July 8, 2006, is unchanged. Source: DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permits 200208093627 and 200407088299 (data.sfgov.org/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=...).
item.source: DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permits 200208093627 and 200407088299 (data.sfgov.org/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=...)

item.description: Mission Bay Branch Library now shows its July 8, 2006 opening. Source: San Francisco Public Library, Mission Bay Library History (https://sfpl.org/locations/mission-bay/mission-bay-library-history).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Branch Library: The Mission Bay library's July 8, 2006 opening now also…
item.description: The Mission Bay library's July 8, 2006 opening now also cites the library's own history page, not only a fact sheet issued beforehand. Source: https://sfpl.org/locations/mission-bay/mission-bay-library-history.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Branch Library: The summary now says the library opened July 8, 2006…
item.description: The summary now says the library opened July 8, 2006 (SFPL's history page) instead of leading with the Assessor's 2005 year built. The Phil'z Coffee entry no longer gives an opening date: 2007-04-01 is a business-registration date in DataSF, and Phil'z's own locations page only shows the 201 Berry St store operating now. The record's notes no longer call the Assessor's 201 Berry St address stale, since Phil'z is registered at that address, and now cite the DataSF Assessor roll and parcels. Source: San Francisco Public Library, Mission Bay Library history (https://sfpl.org/locations/mission-bay/mission-bay-library-history); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis); Phil'z Coffee, locations (https://www.philzcoffee.com/locations); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8708110 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8708110); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn).
item.source: San Francisco Public Library, Mission Bay Library history (https://sfpl.org/locations/mission-bay/mission-bay-library-history); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis); Phil'z Coffee, locations (https://www.philzcoffee.com/locations); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8708110 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8708110); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn)

item.title: Added · Mission Bay Branch Library: Phil'z Coffee's own locations page (philzcoffee.com/locations…
item.description: Phil'z Coffee's own locations page (philzcoffee.com/locations, read 2026-09-29) lists a Berry store at 201 Berry St with opening hours. DataSF Registered Business Locations shows a registration there with a location start date of 2007-04-01, which is a registration date, not a confirmed opening date, so no opening date is given. Source: https://www.philzcoffee.com/locations; https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Branch Library: The Mission Bay Branch Library's completion date corrected
item.description: The Mission Bay Branch Library's completion date corrected. The earlier entry gave a rough 2005 year from a weak guess based on DataSF Assessor data. SFPL's own "Facts & Figures" PDF, already checked directly and confirmed during earlier research verification, states the actual grand opening was July 8, 2006, and adds a Dec 10, 2003 groundbreaking as a real earlier stage. The confirmed date had not been applied to the record at the time; this was caught on a later re-check. Source: San Francisco Public Library, "Mission Bay Branch Library Facts & Figures" (sfpl.org/archive/blip/missionbayfaq.pdf).
item.source: San Francisco Public Library, "Mission Bay Branch Library Facts & Figures" (sfpl.org/archive/blip/missionbayfaq.pdf)

item.title: Added · Mission Bay Branch Library: Mission Bay Branch Library added as an active Assessor-parcel…
item.description: Mission Bay Branch Library added as an active Assessor-parcel record (blklot 8708110, 960 4th St, built 2005). The Assessor tax roll's own property location for this parcel reads '201 BERRY ST', a different street address from the library's 4th St address; Phil'z Coffee is registered at that same 201 Berry St address in DataSF Registered Business Locations, so it is a live address, not a stale one. Source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8708110); DataSF Parcels - Active and Retired (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis); San Francisco Public Library, Mission Bay Library history (https://sfpl.org/locations/mission-bay/mission-bay-library-history).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Branch Library: DBI records the new-construction permit… (Mar 8, 2007)
item.description: DBI records the new-construction permit 200208093627 ("erect 7 story 140 dwelling units, office, library, retail & parking" at 201 Berry St; filed 2002-08-09, issued 2003-07-29) as completed. This is the permit's completed date for the whole building, not the library's opening (Mar 8, 2007). Source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection via DataSF (i98e-djp9).
item.source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection via DataSF (i98e-djp9)

item.title: Complete · Mission Bay Branch Library: Opened: San Francisco Public Library's… (Jul 8, 2006)
item.description: Opened: San Francisco Public Library's Mission Bay Library history page states the branch opened its doors on this date. (Jul 8, 2006). Source: San Francisco Public Library.

item.description: Mission Bay Branch Library opens (grand opening); architect Santos Prescott and Associates, building architect Hardison Komatsu Ivelich and Tucker, developer Mercy Housing California, general contractor Cahill Contractors (Jul 8, 2006). Source: San Francisco Public Library, "Mission Bay Branch Library Facts & Figures" (sfpl.org/archive/blip/missionbayfaq.pdf); https://sfpl.org/locations/mission-bay/mission-bay-library-history.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Branch Library: DBI issues permit 200407088299 (filed July… (Apr 19, 2005)
item.description: DBI issues permit 200407088299 (filed July 8, 2004) for an interior improvement of shell space "to create branch library" at 201 Berry St, estimated cost $1,500,000; DBI's record lists its status as expired (status date 2011-11-02), with no completion date (Apr 19, 2005). Source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection via DataSF (i98e-djp9).
item.source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection via DataSF (i98e-djp9)

item.title: Under construction · Mission Bay Branch Library: Official groundbreaking for the… (Dec 10, 2003)
item.description: Official groundbreaking for the Mission Bay Branch Library, a 7,500 sq ft branch at 960 4th St (funded by the $105.9M Branch Library Improvement Program bond measure approved by voters in Nov 2000) (Dec 10, 2003). Source: San Francisco Public Library, "Mission Bay Branch Library Facts & Figures".
